issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וּמִלְאוּ יָדוֹ' (literally 'and they shall fill its hand') is an idiom meaning 'to consecrate/ordain' (fill the hand with an offering for installation). The Chinese '為它舉手行聖別' ('raise hands for it to consecrate') misinterprets the idiom as a hand-raising gesture, changing the meaning from ordination/consecration to a different ritual action.
